increment_paragraph: **AUDIT-CANONICAL-PATHS (seam F; user decision 7).** The [card](../../reports/audit-canonical-paths/README.md) makes the audit select units by located path. A path that resolves is canonicalised: symlinks resolve, and `.`/`..` apply as the kernel applies them, including a symlinked database `directory` with a relative `file`. A path that does not resolve is located through its deepest existing ancestor and never treated as resolving. The comparison lives in `crates/qcore-audit/src/input_paths.rs` and serves every selection site: pinned `plan_library`, configured `select_configurations`, explicit selections, the configuration route, Monkey, observed-wait, outer reach and the pre-pass input test. The cross-unit home key and the unit file key use it too. Selected records keep their spelling, so Clang reads the recorded spelling (constraint 11), and published paths and digests are unchanged for a consistently spelled database. Two refusals are new: a record spelled under a root that resolves outside it gets the route's existing outside-root diagnostic, and two spellings of one source the named `input-path-alias`. Unit and route tests cover a symlinked checkout, outside-root, dangling, alias and relative-file cases. Identity run, after attempt 1 failed at the Monkey gate because `git archive` snapshots lack the libevent submodule: per-side snapshots built and run at one path in private mount namespaces, routes in `gate_slot.py` audit slots. BASE on the original, unmirrored inputs fails exactly as run 4 did. TIP on them runs corpus, slice and system to completion, and every unit status, row status and null verdict equals BASE-through-the-mirror: corpus 1,009 Safe / 3,816 Unknown / 9 Unsafe, slice 57/4/342/1, system 99/345/4. TIP and BASE through the mirror are byte-identical except one clock-dependent pre-pass key (`mk_bin/monkey.c`'s `__DATE__ __TIME__`). Against BASE reading the same original spelling (old prefix as a bind mount), TIP differs, after rewriting its resolved root prefix, only in digests over canonical paths that spell that root (configuration records, the ChunkIO frame-helper import), the member pre-pass's mixed spelling of its evidence files, and that key. Against the mirror, every digest over the spelled record and every `__FILE__`-derived length differs, as constraint 11 requires. The report states this and does not claim a one-to-one substitution.
status_paragraph: The pinned corpus, the configured system route and the tail-pause slice run directly on the original pinned inputs after the checkout move (AUDIT-CANONICAL-PATHS): unit selection compares located paths, so the re-spelled mirror (`mirror_inputs.py`) is no longer needed. Verdicts are unchanged on all three routes.

ledger.why: DISCHARGE (AUDIT-CANONICAL-PATHS, docs/reports/audit-canonical-paths/README.md): the audit compares canonical paths in every unit-selection site (crates/qcore-audit/src/input_paths.rs), with its own gate. BASE parity: TIP 26a1acd2d on the original, unmirrored inputs runs corpus, slice and system to completion. Its unit statuses, row statuses and null verdicts equal BASE fb5412930 through the mirror on every row (corpus 185 units, 4,834 rows; slice 16/404; system 15/448), while BASE on the same original inputs reproduces run 4's two failures. Byte-level residue is stated in the report: digests over the spelled record (constraint 11), the member pre-pass's mixed spelling (MEMBER-PREPASS-MIXED-SPELLING) and a clock-dependent pre-pass key (PREPASS-CLOCK-DEPENDENT-KEY).

ledger.title: Member pre-pass mixes the route root's canonical spelling with the database's
ledger.text: Found by AUDIT-CANONICAL-PATHS's identity run on the original inputs after the checkout move. member_prepass.rs exclusion_files joins a TokensAbsent exclusion's generator sources under the route's canonical source root, but takes the unit and its dependencies in the compile database's spelling. When the two differ (a moved or symlinked checkout), the evidence-file set holds one file under two spellings. Each is read twice (slice/system admission phase 3: 814 tasks against 676), and the sorted order changes which file a dropped unit's reason cites first (74 reasons, all luajit build-tool units). No dropping decision, verdict or count changes. DISCHARGE: dedupe and order the pre-pass's evidence files by located path (crates/qcore-audit/src/input_paths.rs), keeping the spelled path for publication. Evidence: an identity run on the original inputs whose slice and system sidecars equal the namespace control's apart from root-prefix digests.

ledger.title: One pre-pass summary key changes with the clock, so route sidecars are not reproducible
ledger.text: Found by AUDIT-CANONICAL-PATHS. The Fluent Bit compile database compiles lib/monkey/mk_bin/monkey.c, whose MONKEY_BUILT is `__DATE__ " " __TIME__`. The member pre-pass keys each unit's lifetime-source summary by a digest over its preprocessed text, so that unit's key (an empty summary) differs between any two runs not in the same second. It shows in both the evidence and pre-pass sections of the .contracts.json sidecar on the corpus, system and slice routes. Verdicts are unaffected, but no two runs of a route are byte-identical, which every identity run must then explain. DISCHARGE: preprocess under a fixed, recorded SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH (Clang honours it for __DATE__ and __TIME__), or refuse or normalise the time macros in the identity. Evidence: two runs of one route byte-identical.

ledger.title: Measurement snapshots: missing submodule, shared working directory, git index refresh, build stamp
ledger.text: Found by AUDIT-CANONICAL-PATHS while measuring from git-archive snapshots, for the MEASURE-TOOL card (seam F). (1) git archive omits third_party/libevent. The pinned route reads it through the binary's compile-time CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR, so the corpus fails at the Monkey gate with the enclosing worktree's HEAD. (2) The audit writes transient retained products under its working directory (private/audit-retained-products/), so two routes sharing a snapshot trip each other's input-identity check (driver exit 101). (3) The audit's git refreshes a fresh clone's .git/index during the route, also exit 101. (4) QCORE_AUDIT_BUILD_COMMIT (evidence_version) is the HEAD of whatever repository encloses the build directory, not the measured revision. (5) The snapshot directory reaches the contract-source paths the reports digest, so sides at different paths can never be byte-compared. scripts/pin_run.sh and run_pinned_paths.sh in the report show one workaround. DISCHARGE: quirin-audit measure prepares snapshots with submodules at one fixed path per side, runs each with a private working directory, excludes VCS metadata from the identity check and records the measured revision explicitly.
